title: Tiki Boat River Float (1-Hour) - Portland, OR
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Life jackets are available on board for kids 12 and under.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Escape to an island paradise without leaving PDX on this tropical happy hour cruise!

Sip a delicious drink, take in the city sights, and catch up with old friends or meet new ones aboard Portland's only tiki-style river boat. Depending on the day, crew and crowd, vibes vary from lively and energetic to chill and relaxing.

Come connect, take in the fresh air and celebrate a special occasion—or just life itself! At Island Style Charters, every day is a party.

**Perfect for:** Happy hour • Celebrations • Work Groups • Travelers • Afternoon Dates • "Just because"

**Highlights:** Tropical tiki boat • Downtown river views • Music, drinks & snacks available for purchase

**Cruise Duration:** 1 hour

**August:** 4:30 PM check-in, 5:00–6:00 PM cruise. **September & October times vary** Please review all booking details and communications carefully before your cruise.
